originalReference.name: keeper_walk
originalReference.rule: Every accepted sheet is compared with this untouched original at identical fixed scale; direct silhouettes additionally pass a 0.960-1.040 skull-to-sole ratio gate.

rules.upright: inferred skull top to supporting sole; headwear, raised limbs and props excluded
rules.seatedCrouched: head unit plus articulated shoulder-hip-sole chain; compressed silhouette height is never used as scale
rules.horizontalSwimmingExercise: head unit plus articulated skull-hip-sole chain measured along the body axis
rules.costume: infer skull under headwear from face, ear and neck landmarks; costume bulk is excluded from core width
rules.rearView: infer skull from cap band or hair crown and use shoulder/hip/sole landmarks
rules.rule: One uniform scale is applied to the whole frame sequence. Never fit the keeper to the canvas or to a prop. Increase transparent canvas space instead.
